treatment.hook: Paige lifts a carton of eggs and, at the end of the aisle, a man in a gray sweatsuit is staring straight at her, then looks away too fast. Store hum, a cart wheel ticking, then her quiet thought: 'Weird. But whatever.'
treatment.logline: A woman shopping alone notices men in identical gray sweatsuits who buy nothing and follow her, and when a van pulls up in the dark parking lot, the little alarm on her keys is the only voice she has.
treatment.why_it_holds: The viewer spots the pattern before she does and waits for her to catch up, and the dread builds from a staring man to three men to a van with its door already open. The parking lot is a clear question (will she get the pin out in time?) and the siren answers it loudly.
treatment.ending: The siren and strobe turn the whole lot toward the men, who walk back to their van like they forgot something, and a stranger runs after them filming. It ends on Paige locked in her car, keys held to her chest, with the strobe still flickering across her face: safe, shaking, and nothing added after.

roles.name: Paige
roles.description: A woman in her late 20s, an ordinary shopper in a green puffer jacket and jeans, hair tied back, a canvas tote on her shoulder; a small key ring alarm hangs from her car keys.

roles.name: Man in Gray
roles.description: One of a crew of men in their 30s, broad-shouldered, in the same plain gray sweatsuit and tan work boots, blank patient faces, hands in pockets or empty.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: A store manager in her 40s in a red polo and a name badge, holding a clipboard, a pleasant but distracted face.

roles.name: Dana
roles.description: A woman in her 40s at home in a soft cardigan, a dish towel over her shoulder, relaxed and cheerful.

roles.name: Cart Kid
roles.description: A teenage store worker in a red polo and a lanyard, pushing a long line of shopping carts.

places.name: Target store
places.description: A big-box store at 6:40 in the evening: long aisles of shelves, red signs, cool flat white fluorescent light, freezers humming at the back, self-checkout stands near the front.

places.name: Parking lot
places.description: The back half of a store parking lot at dusk, half-empty, one tall light flickering half out, cars scattered, cold bluish dusk sky.

clips.name: Aisle watchers
clips.summary: Paige takes eggs off the shelf and spots a gray-suited man staring at her, then a second and a third elsewhere in the store.
clips.setting: Evening, flat cool store light, few shoppers, shelves in soft focus.
clips.sound: store hum, a cart wheel ticking, freezers buzzing

shots.action: Paige's hand lifts a carton of eggs off the shelf; down the aisle, a man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots stands with no cart, hands in his pockets, staring at her.
The man's eyes are on her, then he looks away too fast, a stiff turn of the head.
Paige holds the eggs, a small frown, her lips stay closed.
shots.how: voice-over, lips closed, flat and unsure

shots.camera: Wide through a gap in the shelves, locked
shots.action: In the next aisle a second man in the same gray sweatsuit and boots stands with empty hands.
shots.extras: a man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots, nothing in his hands

shots.action: By the freezers, a third man in the same gray sweatsuit stands still beside the glass doors.
shots.extras: a man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots by the freezers, empty-handed

shots.action: Paige walks on with her basket, shrugging it off, then glances toward the cereal aisle ahead and turns into it.
shots.how: voice-over, lips closed, talking herself into it

clips.name: Nobody's buying
clips.summary: Aisle after aisle another gray man crosses just past her, until she sees none of them is holding anything.
clips.setting: Cereal aisle and the next, the same flat store light, long rows of bright boxes.
clips.sound: store hum, rubber wheels, footsteps passing

shots.action: Paige turns down the cereal aisle; at the far end a man in a gray sweatsuit walks past the opening, not turning his head.
shots.extras: a man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots crossing the far end of the aisle

shots.action: She turns down the next aisle; another gray man crosses the far end the same way, not toward her, just past, as her eyes track him.
shots.extras: a second man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots crossing the far end

shots.camera: Macro insert on the basket, locked
shots.action: Her hand shifts the basket: a carton of milk and the eggs.

shots.camera: Wide, locked, her back in the foreground
shots.action: Paige looks up: three men in gray sweatsuits stand at the ends of three aisles, each with empty hands.
shots.extras: three men in gray sweatsuits and work boots at the ends of aisles, hands empty

shots.action: Her face goes still as it clicks, a tight swallow, eyes wide.
shots.how: voice-over, lips closed, a realization, low

clips.name: Self-checkout
clips.summary: A manager asks if she found everything, and Paige, glancing back at the aisles, says yes and pays.
clips.setting: The self-checkout stands near the front doors, the same cool light, a clock reading 6:52.
clips.sound: scanner beeps, store hum, a distant cart

shots.action: Paige stands at a self-checkout stand with her basket; ten feet away a manager in a red shirt reads a clipboard. Paige turns and looks at her.
The manager lifts her eyes from the clipboard, a polite blank face.
Paige glances back toward the aisles; at the far end a gray-suited man stands very still.
shots.extras: a man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots at the end of the aisle

shots.action: Paige turns back with a stiff small smile, eyes still flat.
She scans her eggs with a beep; beyond her the manager goes back to her clipboard. Paige looks out at the dark glass doors.

clips.name: Dana checks the dot
clips.summary: At home, Dana sees Paige's dot sitting in the Target lot, is satisfied, and turns on the oven.
clips.setting: A warm kitchen at evening, lamp on, a pot and a dish towel on the counter, windows dark blue.
clips.sound: kitchen hum, a fridge, a gas oven clicking on

shots.action: Her phone shows a map with Paige's dot sitting in the Target parking lot.
Dana looks at the phone and smiles, relieved.
She puts the phone face down on the counter and turns the oven knob; the burner clicks and the blue flame catches. The click carries into the next scene.

clips.name: The van
clips.summary: Paige nears her car as a white van rolls up with its door open and two men walk straight at her.
clips.setting: Dusk, the tall light half out and buzzing, Paige's car three steps away.
clips.sound: wind, a buzzing light, tires on gravel, boots

shots.camera: Wide low angle, slow push in
shots.action: Paige walks toward her car with her keys in one hand and the grocery bag in the other, her breath visible.
A white van rolls up and stops three spaces away; the side door is already open and dark inside.
shots.extras: a white van with its side door open and nobody visible inside

shots.action: Paige stops, eyes on the open door, grip tight on her keys.
shots.how: voice-over, lips closed, low and tight

shots.action: Two men in gray sweatsuits step out of the van and walk straight at her, not fast, just straight.
shots.extras: a second man in the same gray sweatsuit and work boots beside him

shots.camera: Close-up, long lens, slow push in
shots.action: The man in front keeps coming with an easy flat smile, one hand lifting palm-out.

clips.name: Pull the pin
clips.summary: Paige freezes and cannot scream, then her thumb finds the alarm on her keys and she pulls the pin.
clips.setting: The same half-lit corner, the two men a few steps away, her car just behind her.
clips.sound: wind, a buzzing light, her breath, boots stopping

shots.action: Paige's face is frozen, her eyes on the men, a short breath.
shots.how: voice-over, lips closed, quiet and tense

shots.action: She opens her mouth and no sound comes out, her throat working.
shots.how: voice-over, lips open but silent, rising panic

shots.camera: Macro insert on her hand, locked
shots.action: Her thumb slides across her key ring and finds the small Palace Guard alarm.
The grocery bag drops from her hand as she grabs her keys with both hands, and the egg carton hits the asphalt.
Her fingers yank the pin out of the alarm; the strobe is about to light.

clips.name: The siren
clips.summary: The siren and strobe fill the lot, bystanders turn around, and the two men stop.
clips.setting: The lot erupts in white strobe light, shoppers further off in soft focus.
clips.sound: a piercing siren echoing across the lot, a stroller rolling

shots.action: The siren starts and the strobe flashes white on the van; Paige stands rigid with the alarm in her fist.
shots.extras: a white van with its side door open

shots.action: A man loading his trunk two rows over turns around.
shots.extras: a man loading his car trunk

shots.action: The kid pushing a line of carts turns around.
A woman with a stroller stops so fast that the stroller rolls a foot ahead of her.
The two men stop mid-stride in the strobe, then look at each other.
shots.extras: a second man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots

clips.name: They back off
clips.summary: The men walk back to the van like they forgot something, the van pulls out, the cart kid chases it, and Paige locks herself in her car.
clips.setting: Siren still wailing, the strobe flashing across the lot and the cars.
clips.sound: the siren, a van engine, running footsteps, a car door and locks

shots.action: The two men turn and walk back to the van like they forgot something.
shots.extras: a second man in a gray sweatsuit and work boots

shots.action: The van pulls out with its side door still open.
shots.extras: a white van with its side door open

shots.action: The cart kid lets go of his carts and runs after the van with his phone up.
Paige gets into her car, locks the doors, and holds her keys against her chest; the strobe flickers across her face.
